title: Follow-up: GCLI-11 review nits - export namespace members, anonymous default class members, non-public resolver API, localeCompare
description: Theoretical findings from reviewer unit glyph-cli-review-73 at db3611c on opum-ai/glyph-cli#73 (GCLI-11), filed as one follow-up and not admitted. (7) A member of an exported TypeScript namespace (export namespace N { ... }) is marked exported by the top-level-declaration rule even when the member itself is not exported, so the namespace-importer trigger can over-approximate. (8) Members of an anonymous default-exported class are not symbols and are not reached. (9) src/indexer.ts resolves module specifiers through program.getResolvedModuleFromModuleSpecifier, which is present at runtime but absent from the public typings; the fallback is the checker's module symbol. (10) src/queries.ts:17 sorts with localeCompare, which can depend on the host ICU locale, unlike the codepoint order impact.ts uses. Not started.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each of the four findings is either fixed with a test that fails without the fix, or closed with a recorded reason it is not worth fixing.
bun run check passes and no existing call, new, import or heritage answer changes except where a finding names it.

implementationNotes: Notes from the #73 confirmatory round (Opus reviewer unit, APPROVED 244a0b0). (i) THEORETICAL divergence: ValueModule also matches an instantiated 'namespace N {}'. ModuleDeclaration is not indexed, so a plain-namespace 'export = N' becomes a module edge to the FILE rather than an unresolved import (DEC-216 (a5) item 4, read strictly). Fix is to drop the ValueModule disjunct (declarations.some(ts.isSourceFile) alone covers the whole-module case) or keep it and name the case in ADR 0004; the leader is asking opum-doc which. (ii) ADR 0004's changed-fields list omits unresolvedSites growing (the --ref node_modules test goes 1 -> 2, test/cli.test.ts:524). (iii) ADR 0004's Contract section does not name the new 'exported' field on every symbol object.
